title: Etsy Listings & Seller Intel Input
description: Pull public Etsy listings and seller intel by keyword or shop. No login. Pay per listing.

queries.title: Search keywords
queries.description: Keywords to search the Etsy catalog. Each query runs as one search. Examples: 'wedding invitation', 'vintage typewriter', 'leather wallet'.

shopUrls.title: Shop URLs or names
shopUrls.description: Pull every active listing from these Etsy shops, plus shop-level intel. Accepts full shop URLs (e.g. 'https://www.etsy.com/shop/Beardbrand') or raw shop names ('Beardbrand').

maxListingsPerSource.title: Max listings per source
maxListingsPerSource.description: Stop paginating for a given query or shop once this many listings have been collected. Higher numbers add latency and proxy cost.

country.title: Etsy region
country.description: Etsy regional storefront. Determines pricing currency and shipping defaults shown.

includeShopIntel.title: Include shop-level intel on each row
includeShopIntel.description: Embed shop sales, years active, location, star seller status, and overall rating onto every listing row. Pulls one extra fetch per unique shop seen during the run.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of search and shop pages processed in parallel. Five is a safe default for Etsy.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Residential is required at any meaningful volume.
